topic: iqbal sobhan chowdhury arrested in july uprising case
headline_marked: Former PM adviser [[Iqbal Sobhan Chowdhury arrested]] in July uprising murder case
headline: Former PM adviser Iqbal Sobhan Chowdhury arrested in July uprising murder case
summary: Police confirmed his arrest in connection with a murder case filed with Jatrabari Police Station on August 26, 2024, related to the recent unrest. Rajib Ghosh, also detained, has since been released.
details: Police have arrested Iqbal Sobhan Chowdhury, former information adviser to ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina, in a murder case filed over the July uprising. He was shown arrested in connection with a case filed with Jatrabari Police Station on August 26, 2024.
Shafiqul Islam, chief of Dhaka Metropolitan Police’s Detective Branch, confirmed the arrest last night. The case pertains to a murder that occurred during the widespread unrest in July.

Iqbal, former chairman of private television channel DBC, was picked up from the channel’s Mohakhali office. Rajib Ghosh, special correspondent of DBC News, who was also detained, has since been released.

Initially, DMP Deputy Commissioner Md Akhter Hossain stated that both were taken to the DB office for questioning following a situation arising from a published report. Their colleagues had confirmed Iqbal Sobhan was taken for questioning.
caption:
Former information adviser to ousted PM Sheikh Hasina, Iqbal Sobhan Chowdhury, has been arrested in a murder case linked to the July uprising.

Police have arrested Iqbal Sobhan Chowdhury, former information adviser to ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina, in a murder case filed over the July uprising. He was shown arrested in connection with a case filed with Jatrabari Police Station on August 26, 2024.

Shafiqul Islam, chief of Dhaka Metropolitan Police’s Detective Branch, confirmed the arrest last night. The case pertains to a murder that occurred during the widespread unrest in July.

Iqbal, former chairman of private television channel DBC, was picked up from the channel’s Mohakhali office. Rajib Ghosh, special correspondent of DBC News, who was also detained, has since been released.

Initially, DMP Deputy Commissioner Md Akhter Hossain stated that both were taken to the DB office for questioning following a situation arising from a published report. Their colleagues had confirmed Iqbal Sobhan was taken for questioning.
